title: Mechanism Design Is Not Enough: Prosocial Agents for Cooperative AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'prosociality' of AI agents—defined as their intrinsic motivation to weigh others' welfare—and benchmarks this using 'moral hazard' extensions of social dilemmas like the Prisoner's Dilemma. It evaluates the ability of agents to reach socially optimal (utilitarian) outcomes versus selfish ones.
